tasks.title: Design test audit and consolidation strategy
tasks.description:
Create comprehensive strategy for auditing 5,889 tests against NECESSARY pattern and software engineering best practices.

NECESSARY Pattern (9 categories):
- Normal: Standard usage paths
- Edge: Boundary conditions, edge cases
- Cascading: Error propagation, side effects
- Essential: Critical business logic
- Security: Auth, injection, XSS, CSRF
- Spec: Acceptance criteria validation
- Accessibility: Inclusive design
- Resilience: Error recovery, timeouts
- Year-round: Time-based logic, DST

Audit Criteria:
1. NECESSARY compliance (which categories covered?)
2. Test quality (AAA pattern, clear assertions, focused)
3. Duplication (similar tests, consolidation opportunities)
4. Value (does it catch real bugs or just noise?)
5. Maintenance burden (flaky, overly complex, brittle)
6. Coverage gaps (what's NOT tested but should be?)

Decision Framework:
- KEEP: High value, clear purpose, catches bugs, maintainable
- CONSOLIDATE: Duplicate/similar tests, merge into parameterized test
- ENHANCE: Good intent but incomplete NECESSARY coverage
- REPLACE: Outdated approach, better pattern available
- DELETE: Zero value (always passes, redundant, tests implementation not behavior)

Output: Surgical plan preserving honey, removing cruft.
acceptance_criteria: NECESSARY pattern criteria defined for all 9 categories
Test quality rubric created (AAA, assertions, focus)
Duplication detection strategy (AST similarity, naming patterns)
Value assessment criteria (bug detection history, failure rate)
Expected reduction target (10-20% consolidation without losing coverage)

tasks.title: Build automated test audit analyzer
tasks.description:
Create tools/test_audit_analyzer.py to automatically analyze 5,889 tests.

Features:
1. NECESSARY Pattern Detection:
   - Scan test names for category keywords (test_normal_, test_edge_, test_security_)
   - Analyze test body for pattern compliance (assertions, error handling)
   - Generate coverage matrix (which categories have gaps?)

2. Quality Metrics:
   - AAA pattern detection (Arrange, Act, Assert sections)
   - Assertion count (too few = weak test, too many = unfocused)
   - Test length (>50 lines = candidate for split)
   - Complexity (cyclomatic complexity, nested loops)

3. Duplication Detection:
   - AST similarity (85%+ similar = consolidation candidate)
   - Naming pattern analysis (test_foo_1, test_foo_2 = parameterize?)
   - Setup/teardown duplication (shared fixture opportunity)

4. Value Analysis:
   - Parse git history for test failure frequency
   - Identify tests that never fail (always-passing = low value?)
   - Runtime analysis (slow tests that could be optimized)

5. Reporting:
   - JSON report per test file with recommendations
   - Summary dashboard (total tests, NECESSARY coverage %, consolidation opportunities)
   - Prioritized action list (high-impact improvements first)

Output: Actionable analysis of all 5,889 tests.
acceptance_criteria: AST parsing for test structure analysis
Git history analysis for failure frequency
JSON report generation per test file

tasks.title: Create surgical test consolidation plan
tasks.description:
Based on audit report, create surgical plan for test suite optimization.

Plan Structure:
1. PRESERVE (Honey - 60-70%):
   - High-value tests (catch real bugs)
   - Good NECESSARY coverage
   - Clear, maintainable, focused
   - NO CHANGES (these are gold)

2. CONSOLIDATE (10-15%):
   - Duplicate/similar tests → parameterized tests
   - Example: test_foo_valid_1, test_foo_valid_2 → @pytest.mark.parametrize
   - Shared setup/teardown → fixtures
   - Similar assertions → helper functions

3. ENHANCE (15-20%):
   - Good tests with incomplete NECESSARY coverage
   - Add edge cases, security checks, resilience tests
   - Improve assertions (more specific, better error messages)
   - Add docstrings explaining what bug this catches

4. DELETE (5-10%):
   - Always-passing tests (zero failures in git history)
   - Redundant after consolidation
   - Testing implementation details (not behavior)
   - Overly complex, brittle, unmaintainable

5. REPLACE (5%):
   - Outdated patterns (better approach available)
   - Integration tests that should be unit tests
   - Slow tests that could be faster

Output: Prioritized action plan with examples, estimated impact.
acceptance_criteria: CONSOLIDATE plan (parameterization opportunities with code examples)
ENHANCE plan (NECESSARY gaps to fill with specific recommendations)
REPLACE plan (outdated patterns with modern alternatives)
Impact estimate (coverage maintained, runtime reduced, maintenance easier)
Risk assessment (what could break, mitigation strategies)

tasks.title: Verify test audit analyzer correctness
tasks.description:
Create tests for test_audit_analyzer to ensure accurate analysis.

Test Cases:
1. NECESSARY Pattern Detection:
   - Test with complete NECESSARY coverage → 9/9 categories detected
   - Test with gaps → missing categories identified
   - Test with wrong patterns → flagged for enhancement

2. Quality Metrics:
   - Well-structured test (AAA pattern) → high quality score
   - Poorly structured test → low quality score, specific issues identified
   - Complex test (>50 lines) → flagged for split

3. Duplication Detection:
   - Identical tests → 100% similarity, consolidation recommended
   - Similar tests (85% overlap) → consolidation candidate
   - Different tests → no false positives

4. Value Analysis:
   - Test with failure history → high value, preserve
   - Always-passing test → low value, deletion candidate

5. Edge Cases:
   - Empty test file → graceful handling
   - Malformed test → error reported, analysis continues
   - Large test suite (1000+ tests) → performance acceptable

Output: Confidence in audit analyzer accuracy.
acceptance_criteria: Test quality metrics calculation (AAA, assertions, complexity)
Test edge case handling (empty files, malformed tests)
Test performance (5,889 tests analyzed in <5 minutes)
Test report generation (JSON, HTML output valid)
